args.subject: Group booking inquiry - 10 people in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am organizing a group stay at your hotel. I am writing to inquire about availability for a group of 10 people in June.

Could you please provide information on:
- Room availability for 10 people during June 2024
- Group rates or special packages
- Any specific requirements or policies for group bookings
- Booking process and deposit requirements

I look forward to your response and hope to arrange our stay at City Hub Tokyo.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
+1 327-420-4923

2. **Found the group bookings contact**: From the hotel reviews, I discovered the group bookings email addresses: `groups@contact-mail.org` and `groups.work@contact-mail.org`
